title: The frozen world's fish, once it first climbs on its water row's own thrust, pins a state hash past that climb
binding: The positive leg boots puck.world.frozen.json headless, waits 720 ticks (past fishKit's wander producer first commanding MoveUp and the water row's thrust folding that into the medium convergence), and reads world.state.hash — pinning the state past the point where the fish's own vertical channel first diverges from a body that never climbs. The discriminating leg re-runs the identical boot but reads the hash at tick 480 instead: a different, independently-observed value, proving the pinned tick-720 hash is not some hash the simulation would already report before the fish acts, but state that has genuinely kept moving.
